dex.entry: A stocky bipedal kin that has grown up around its ore core; fists and elbows reinforced with raw iron protrusions, and new ore deposits form on its shoulders. The mid-form that looks like it means business — ore-plated and ready to brawl.

art.silhouette: Short biped with a barrel chest; iron-ore growth on both fists and elbows like natural knuckledusters; shoulder ore-knobs; dark grey skin with metallic flecks; small determined face.
